primitives.name: Product Development Workflow Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Product Development Strategy As of: 2026-06-09 ## Product Development Workflow 1.
primitives.assumptions: Workflow stages are ordered and conditionally dependent; each stage must be validated before proceeding.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When any stage fails validation, workflow halts until resolution.

primitives.name: Penpot Design System Candidate
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Penpot Use Penpot as an internal design-system candidate, not an immediate Figma replacement.
primitives.assumptions: Design tokens are consistent across platforms and represent semantic UI elements.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When Penpot adoption is abandoned, fallback to design notes is required.

primitives.name: Hoppscotch API Testing Framework
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Hoppscotch Use Hoppscotch immediately as a docs-first API testing plan.
primitives.assumptions: API collections are comprehensive and reflect all service interfaces.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When API contracts are ambiguous, testing coverage degrades.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's API contract validation and GSE's integration testing logic.

primitives.name: Cap Visual Evidence Repository
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Cap Use Cap for QA videos, bug repros, onboarding clips, support replies, release notes, customer trust explainers, enterprise demos, and visual evidence packets.
primitives.assumptions: Visual artifacts are non-sensitive and directly correlate with user experience.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When sensitive content is recorded, repository access is restricted.
